name: ihris-4-on-fhir
title: iHRIS 4 on FHIR
description: NEW DERIVED CONTENT: the iHRIS 4.3.3 data model expressed in FHIR. It covers generated FSH for the terminology, logical models, and StructureMaps to the three iHRIS 5 IGs, built with SUSHI. It is built on fhir-harness, the bare FHIR IG pipeline with no WHO in it (owner, 2026-10-09: 'update ihris fhir ... to make use of fhir-harness'), which replaces the smart-base harness and IG it depended on from 2026-09-23. So the whole folio, this subgraph included, is independent of smart-base, and the IG depends on hl7.fhir.r4.core only (D5). Generated (owner, 2026-10-09: 'all'): the terminology as FSH (build_dak.py; the terminology JSON is SUSHI's build) and the 51 logical models (gen_fsh.py), built clean by SUSHI 3.20.1. F4 (bean ihris-7gl8): the logical models are matched to the three iHRIS 5 IGs by name and label equality only (src/tools/map_ihris5.py), with StructureMaps generated for the exact matches, a two-way gap report, and proposals for the owner where the evidence does not decide.

dependsOn.name: fhir-harness
dependsOn.note: the bare FHIR IG pipeline: SUSHI, the IG Publisher and its AST fork, the just-the-docs render. Pinned and mounted by index.config.json.

dependsOn.note: FHIR R4 core 4.0.1, the only IG dependency (D5); the same FHIR version as iHRIS 5
